attributes.question_bank_id: string, REQUIRED - natural key alongside path quiz_id
attributes.order: integer 0..2147483647 | null - omit to append; service derives Max(order)+10 within the quiz
attributes.randomize_questions: boolean - model column default on first bind

item._extra: forbid - a typo'd field is a 422, not a silently-dropped no-op

bind_quiz_question_banks._CRITICAL_SEMANTICS: Re-binding an already-bound bank is an IDEMPOTENT PARTIAL UPDATE. Only fields the caller actually supplies are written; any writable field OMITTED on re-bind is PRESERVED at its stored value - NOT reset to a schema default, and an omitted `order` is NOT re-derived. Implemented as update_or_create on the natural key, so no IntegrityError.
bind_quiz_question_banks.semantics: quiz_id resolved once up front: malformed/cross-org/soft-deleted quiz is a document-level 404. First-wins dedup on question_bank_id, so a logical bind fires its QuestionBankAssignmentBound event exactly once. Bad question_bank_id is a per-item not_found. 200/207/400.

unbind_quiz_question_banks._shape_note: question_bank_id lives under `attributes`, NOT as a top-level `id` - keeps it symmetric with bind/update and makes the per-item JSON:API pointer resolve to /data/{i}/attributes/question_bank_id.
unbind_quiz_question_banks.semantics: HARD delete - QuestionBankAssignment is not a SoftDeletionModel, rows are permanently removed. A bank not assigned to this quiz is a per-item not_found. 200/207/400.

attributes.is_visible: boolean, DEFAULT true - true = allowlist (show despite default-hidden); false = blocklist (hide despite default-visible)

add_visibility_overrides.semantics: IDEMPOTENT on the (group, published_course, is_visible) tuple - an existing row returns as `succeeded`, no already_exists code. First-wins dedup on (published_course_id, is_visible), pointer at attributes/published_course_id. Group lookup runs BEFORE the envelope guard, so a missing group is 404 regardless of body.
add_visibility_overrides._model_note: The unique constraint is (student_group, published_course, is_visible), so (group, course, true) and (group, course, false) CAN coexist. Skilljar's own note says clients should pick one.

attributes.is_visible: boolean, DEFAULT true - true removes an allowlist override, false removes a blocklist one

remove_visibility_overrides._RESPONSE_QUIRK: BatchDeletedItem.id echoes the request's published_course_id, NOT the override's own obfuscated id - so clients can correlate inputs to outcomes without a separate lookup table. Reproduce this.
remove_visibility_overrides.semantics: Each item in its own transaction.atomic() block, no outer atomic. First-wins dedup on the same tuple. 404 if the group is not in the caller's org, checked before the envelope guard.

attributes.slug: string|null - URL path on the domain. Auto-generated if omitted. Lowercase letters/numbers/dashes, 2+ parts.
attributes.open_access: boolean|null, default false - allow anonymous access

publish_courses.semantics: Publishing the same course to the same domain twice is a PER-ITEM conflict (`already_published`), not a whole-batch failure. 200/207/400.
publish_courses._naming: Named publish_courses (plural) but it is POST /v2/published-courses/ - i.e. CREATE a published course. republish/unpublish are the {id}/publish|unpublish sub-resources.

republish_published_course.desc: Re-publish a previously unpublished course: sets live=true and REASSIGNS the slug.

unpublish_published_course.desc: Unpublish a course from its domain: sets live=false and FREES the slug.

register_oauth_client.desc: Register a new OAuth2 client via unauthenticated Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591).
register_oauth_client._CRITICAL: UNAUTHENTICATED. Public/PKCE clients (token_endpoint_auth_method == "none") get no client_secret; confidential clients get a ONE-TIME client_secret that cannot be retrieved again. Errors use RFC 7591's {error, error_description} shape, NOT api_v2's JSON:API envelope.
register_oauth_client._NO_ORG_BOUND: Skilljar's own docstring says no organization is bound or audited at registration. A DCR client is therefore NOT a substitute for an org-scoped dev credential - see WAITING-FOR-002.
register_oauth_client._our_decision: Goes behind the `admin` profile despite the official server shipping it on. It mints credentials (ADR-005, ROADMAP Block 8).
